brief: The eleventh statue, smooth and smiling calmly, with her palm turned up; Śuka looking at the stone beside her; Dādī tracing a letter in the dust with one finger; the long hall lit by oil lamps.

The tenth statue with sharp sandstone edges holding a small stone bell, an inscription on her plinth; Śuka peering at it; Dādī pointing at a single letter; Lubdhaka's foreman holding up a lamp behind them; early evening light.

A small grey-blue stone spirit with a drum sitting on the carved arm of a golden throne, tapping with both hands; Dādī crouching to talk to her; Śuka on the throne's back tilting his head at a line of carved verse on the seat; Lubdhaka at the back in the shadows.
